author: jracer15
body: Now walls is he second most played gamemode on avicus so how does that make sense?  Well thats because most new players who come to the server are playing he walls, and they are loving it.  And everyone who goes on the forums are not new, many are old.  So why does any of this even matter?  Well look at the post that have to do with walls, the discussion are basically ignored.  This annoys me because walls is a great game that is ignored.  The obvious reason is mostly because everyone says the walls maps are getting boring, make sense, when there's like 9 maps there only so much you can get out of it? How many does nebula have? I know it has much much more maps, and they should add more walls to the rotation.  They said because walls is hard to test but trust me, I'm sure if you look at this walls, test it out on the map dev server it's good, trust me, people just want a good walls map, they don't question it.  The Cove, Medieval, Jailhouse, Winter, and much more would fit great to to the server. So fine, you need proper testing and walls just takes a while, well make public map testing more often, it is simple to ask a group of walls players if this map would be a good addition to the server, a simple yes or no with constructive critizsm and add it to the rotations.  That is the best idea when you consider testing for walls, I've heard its sometimes offered to donors but I don't hear a lot of map testing going on, just from the map devs but not be rude i don't always think they are walls, just nebula maps.  Walls is a great game, it brings survival back to minecraft, where instead of fighting on your own, you being to bond and forge friendships through fighting side by side, unlike nebula there is like 32 people on your team so your not on the idea of let's work together.  This post wasn't made to start a flame war, this was to let my opinion be out because no one listens to me, and I have a feeling after this I will still be ignored, but on the forums there was a section for server feedback so why not?  There isn't a lot who play walls on the forums at least so why is it?  Is it the lack of new walls map?  Try taking a break from nebula and try the walls, you may see what I mean.  Many have said I don't like walls, but has something you just can't get, it's your skills that your testing, the players are the best part, the people are usually new to avicus and they deserve a nice welcome.  So maybe if you see this post you leave a nice feedback like 'maybe I'll give walls a try' or 'as staff we'll see the best we can to have walls be a targeted goal for us to be more new!' Hope you read this as a positive thing!
